children: Brazilian banker Luiz Carlos Trabuco, appointed by President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva to take over as finance minister in January, is expected to have a say in discussions over additional fiscal measures currently under consideration, Treasury Secretary Daniel Leal said on Friday.
At a press conference, Leal called Trabuco highly qualified and said his nomination had been welcomed by markets and the economic team.
